title: The queen
line: A rook and a bishop in one piece.

steps.text: The queen moves along rows, columns and diagonals, as many squares as she likes: a rook and a bishop in one piece.
Tap every black piece this queen can capture.
steps.after: Five pieces stand on her lines. A rook or a bishop alone would reach only some of them.

steps.text: Capture the rook on a4 along the diagonal, like a bishop.
Capture the knight on b1 along the row, like a rook.
She cannot jump. A piece in her way stops her, just as it stops a rook or a bishop.

summary: The queen moves like a rook and a bishop together, along rows, columns and diagonals.
